notes.title: Update 8 is now live!
notes.notes:
[p]Hello Guardians![/p][p] A new free update for Guardians Frontline is now officially live![/p][p][/p][p][b]NEW: Drivable Mech Tech, Mech Stomp:[/b][/p][p]A new upgrade has been added to the Drivable Mech![/p][p]- Once researched, the mech will now deal damage by stomping over enemies as it moves.[/p][p][b]NEW: Utility Belt Tech:[/b][/p][p]Introducing the Utility Belt, designed to hold Keys and Mind Grenades during your missions.[/p][p] - The belt features 2 slots.[/p][p]- Unlock the first slot by researching the first tech![/p][p]- Unlock the second slot with an additional research upgrade![/p][p][/p][p]The belt allows for quick access without taking up weapon or gear slots.[/p][p][/p][p][b]NEW: Tag System[/b][/p][p]With this update, we’re introducing a brand-new Tag System to help players better identify and explore maps. Tags come in two types: player-selected and server-assigned.[/p][p]
[u]Player-Selected Tags[/u][/p][p]These can be chosen by map makers when publishing their maps:[/p][p][/p][p]- Character: For creative maps featuring detailed sculptures or references to popular characters.[/p][p]- 4 Players Map: Highlights maps designed specifically for 4 player teams.[/p][p]- Beginner Map: Welcomes new players with friendly, accessible maps to help them learn and progress.[/p][p]- Dark Content: Used to indicate maps that feature mature or sensitive themes so players can decide if it’s for them.[/p][p][/p][p][u]Server-Automated Tags[/u][/p][p]These are applied automatically based on map data: [/p][p]- Classic: Given to older maps from 2021 and 2022 that haven’t been updated in a while, preserving their legacy. [/p][p]- Extra Difficult: Based on win rate data, alerts players when a map presents an especially tough challenge. The win ratio must be lower than 25%. [/p][p]In the search section you can also filter maps by tag.[/p][p][/p][p][b]NEW: Create/Join Game Info[/b][/p][p]You asked, we delivered! This update brings more transparency and useful information to both the Create Game and Join Game screens.[/p][p]
[u]Map List Enhancements[/u][/p][p]Each map now displays its assigned tag, helping players quickly identify the content type. Additionally, a green checkmark icon will appear in the bottom-left corner of the map tile if you’ve already played it, this progress is tracked and saved per map.[/p][p][u]Create Game Improvements[/u][/p][p]When selecting a map to host a game, you’ll now see extra information to help you decide: the average completion time, win ratio, tag, and whether you’ve already played that map.[/p][p][u]Join Game Info Screen[/u][/p][p]Clicking on an open game now brings up a detailed preview showing the game mode, difficulty, win rate, planet, average game time (when available), current match time, number of players, list of player names, and tag. A green checkmark also appears if you’ve previously played that map.[/p][p]
These additions aim to improve your matchmaking experience and help you choose the right mission with the right crew! [/p][p][/p][p][b]Mind grenade Balance:[/b][/p][p]We've adjusted the Mind Grenade to better align with gameplay balance and reduce overuse in certain scenarios.[/p][p]    - Effect Duration Reduced:[/p][p]       - Base: 60 to 45 seconds[/p][p]       - Tech 1: 120 to 90 seconds[/p][p]       - Tech 2: 240 to 120 seconds[/p][p]    - If the target is already affected by a stun effect (e.g., from the AK2), the mind control duration is halved.[/p][p]    - Base build cost is now 500 crystals with a 30 second craft time.[/p][p]    - Players can hold a maximum of 2 grenades. A third cannot be crafted until at least one is used.[/p][p]    - Each grenade crafted increases the cost of the next by 50% of the base cost, up to a maximum of 1,500 crystals and 90 seconds.[/p][p]    - These rules apply per player, not globally. [/p][p][/p][p][b]NEW: Diamond Map Reward:[/b][/p][p]We recognize that creating a map worthy of Diamond status takes time, effort, and a great deal of creativity. To show our appreciation, we’re introducing a reward system for map makers who reach this milestone.[/p][p]Each time one of your maps reaches Diamond, you’ll earn a base 20,000 XP, multiplied by the total number of Diamond maps you’ve created so far.[/p][p]For example, if you already have 10 Diamond maps, and your 11th map reaches Diamond, you’ll receive 20,000 × 10 = 200,000 XP as a reward for that new Diamond map.[/p][p][i]***NOTE***: During the following days the XP for published maps before the Update will be given retoactively[/i][/p][p]
Thank you for your incredible contributions, keep those amazing maps coming![/p][p][/p][p][b]Major Stability Improvements:[/b][/p][p]In this update, we’ve placed a major focus on improving stability, tackling the most critical issues affecting gameplay. Huge thanks to everyone on Discord, the players who submitted crash reports, and those of you who shared detailed investigations—your help made a big difference.[/p][p]
Here’s what we tackled:[/p][p]- Host Change Lag & Desync: We identified a flaw in the core host switching system. It's now been fixed, which should greatly improve stability when the host leaves or changes.[/p][p]- Back to Ship Crash: A specific bug causing crashes when returning to the ship has been addressed. This should significantly reduce related crashes.[/p][p]- Out of Memory Errors: We've optimized memory handling and cleaned up several memory leaks. This should reduce the frequency of out-of-memory crashes, especially during longer sessions.[/p][p]
Thanks again for all the support and feedback, you’re help make the game better for everyone.[/p][p][/p][p][b]NEW: Galaxy conquests points carry over[/b][/p][p]- If a player does not reach 250 points by the end of a Galaxy Conquest, half of the earned points will be carried over to the next Galaxy Conquest.[/p][p]
[b]NEW: Rating Accolades[/b][/p][p]We’ve added two new accolades to reward players who take the time to rate maps and support the community![/p][p]- Hardened Guardian: Unlocked after rating 50 maps [/p][p]- Marine Guardian: Unlocked after rating 100 maps[/p][p] [/p][p][b]NEW: Robot, Drone, and Cannon Skin Tech:[/b][/p][p]You can now unlock cosmetic skins for your Combat Robot, Drone, and Cannon units by researching a new technology in the tech tree. [/p][p]A selection of new skins is now available and can be unlocked using Crystals. [/p][p][/p][p][b]Improvements:[/b][/p][p]- The main menu in the lobby is now fully synchronized for all players; everyone in the lobby should see the same steps in the galaxy and lists during map creation.[/p][p]- Changed the text in the Galaxy Conquest menu from "Days remaining" to "Days until defeat" to avoid confusion about the Galaxy Conquest duration.[/p][p]- Increased the time to vote after a game from 3 to 6 seconds.[/p][p]- Sentinels, Nests, corrupted Cannons, and corrupted SAM batteries now count toward the Unit Score at the end of the game.[/p][p]    - Sentinels lvl 1: 150 points[/p][p]    - Sentinels Lvl 2: 250 points[/p][p]    - Hive lvl 1: 300 points[/p][p]    - Hive lvl 2: 600 points[/p][p]    - Corrupted Cannon: 200 points[/p][p]    - Corrupted SAM: 200 points[/p][p]- The New and Updated lists now show only one map per player—the last one published or updated.[/p][p]- Added a "Vote to Galaxy" button on the rating screen to increase visibility of the feature.[/p][p]- Increased the base microphone volume so players can hear others more clearly.[/p][p]- Added average game time, win ratio, tag, and completion status to the Create Game screen.[/p][p]- Improved distant grab mechanics, item selection should feel more accurate.[/p][p]- Reduced the grab radius for Keys to prevent accidental grabs.[/p][p]
[b]Fixes:[/b][/p][p]- Fixed an issue with map descriptions overflowing to the right.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue with the list of modifiers and allowed weapons overlapping next to the start game screen.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where the PvP message did not time out and stayed permanently in front of the player.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where Sentinels appeared headless.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where fog volume blocks were blocking enemy projectiles.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where metallic sound effects didn’t play when shooting metal objects.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where environmental SFX were too loud in some cases.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where, if the % modifier to enemies was very high, the buff was applied to all waves.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where hits with weapons in the left hand did not register for the double damage buff.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where the teleport would activate even if its construction was canceled.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where players would lose skins purchased with crystals when switching branches or restoring progress.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where players did not receive crystals and research points from Support Pack 1 and 2.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where reward crates always had gravity enabled, causing them to fly away, spawn incorrectly, or not spawn at all.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where players were unable to grab weapons in certain scenarios.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where some Quest 3 devices rendered dark maps too dark.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue with old maps that had timed doors being incorrectly transformed into key doors.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue preventing players from receiving Galaxy Conquest rewards; missed rewards will now be granted automatically.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue during PvP invitations where the "Waiting for response" message would overlap the invite button.[/p][p]- Fixed a bug that caused lag, desynchronization, and instability when the host of a game changed.[/p][p]- Fixed the issue with the 1000 nests accolade not showing progress. Data was being recorded, so no progress was lost; you might need to destroy one nest to activate the accolade.[/p][p]- Fixed a synchronization issue with the AK2 where the Stun shot wasn’t consistent from the client’s point of view.[/p][p]- Fixed a crash when the bHaptic setting was active and the player did not have a haptic vest.[/p][p]- Fixed a crash that could occur when returning to the ship.[/p][p]- Fixed several memory leaks, which should improve stability and reduce the frequency of "out of memory" errors.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Map Editor:[/b][/p][p]- Added a new circular grate asset. [/p][p]- Added new animated assets:[/p][p]- Small Vent (Space build pack)[/p][p]- Large Vent (Space build pack)[/p][p]- Windmill (Fortress build pack) [/p][p]- Hydraulic Press (Space, Thermogen, Titan Base, and Fortress build packs). The hydraulic press kills players on contact. [/p][p]- Added warp gate particles to the editor as an asset. [/p][p]- Fog volume asset can now be colored using an RGB selector.[/p][p]- Cloud volume asset can now be colored using an RGB selector.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where colored fog appeared white in published maps but displayed correctly in the editor.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where the Tesla ball’s color did not update in published maps despite changes in the editor.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue causing maps to be duplicated every time they were saved.[/p][p][/p][p]That's it for now, Guardians!! As always we hope you like this new update and please let us know what you think about the new features. [/p][p] [/p][p]See you in the frontlines and keep up with the bug killing![/p][p]And thank you very much for your continued support![/p][p]
[/p][p]VirtualAge Games Team[/p][p]
[/p]

[*]Lobby UI Network Replicated: Now all the players can see which missions and sections the owner of the room is selecting in the lobby
[*]Minimap: You can now zoom and pan the minimap

[*]Added 2 new map maker suits

notes.title: Update 1.6 - The Queen Update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

A new free update for Guardians Frontline (Update 6) is now officially live on Meta Quest and Steam!

[b]New stuff[/b]
[list]
[*]The Queen: The Federation has found a new enemy on a remote planet, known as 'the Queen' because of her big size. This enemy has weak points that should be targeted for a quick death (head and tail), attacking other areas will take considerably longer
[*]Bug’s Nydus Tunnels:   The enemy has now built its own portals! They can navigate using these portals, from an entrance to an exit. These entrances and exits can be destroyed with explosives, but they regenerate. To permanently destroy the tunnel, you must destroy both the entrance and exit.
[*]Support The Game: A new control panel in the spaceship allows you to support the developers by purchasing a package of interesting items (research point, minerals, and exclusive avatars). While this is completely optional, the developers will be very grateful for any support, as it helps sustain the game's development
[*]18 New Weapon Skins!
[*]Black Energy Sword Skin 
[*]Conquer Mode Time Limit: Map makers can now set a time limit for their Conquer maps. If the Guardians fail to win before this time runs out, they lose the game. 
[*]Squad only maps. Map makers can now configure the missions to be Squad mode only.
[*]Medic Gun research. On the research panel, there's a new upgrade to the Medic Gun to double its capacity.
[*]New PvP Accolades. Additional achievements have been added for PvP to help push this game mode (Win 5 PvP games,  Kill 10 players in PvP,  Win a supremacy game, Win a deathmatch game, Win a team Deathmatch game, Win a Destroy the Gate game).
[*]New Squad Mode Accolade: Win a Squad mode game.
[/list]
[b]Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*]Two new volume selectors have been added to the settings menu: Weapon's volume and Voice Chat Volume.
[*]Friend lists are now stored on our servers to make sure they aren’t lost anymore when reinstalling the game or the progress from another account.
[*]The Arack and the Queen are now available in Hangar to practice in the spaceship hangar. 
[*]Revive from player list:  You can now revive other players directly from the player list menu, and when reviving the players, they will respawn at a player spawn point.
[*]Added an option to reset the local progress on steam. 
[/list]
[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed being able to exchange magazines from other weapons endlessly increasing the bullet count. 
[*]Falling off the map in squad mode now will just respawn the player without killing them.
[*]Teleport would stop working sometimes due to the angle between the player and the landing spot. 
[*]Fixed being able to get into some places with teleport locomotion
[*]Fixed a rare issue where the galaxy conquest was shown as completed, causing the player to lose all their influence points in that galaxy.
[*]Fixed an issue where the game occasionally failed to give the avatar at the end of the galaxy conquest if the player hadn't opened the galaxy tab and pressed Start.
[*]Fixed pressing joystick while having a mission selected would make the game fail to load that map correctly 
[*]Fixed the Arack behaving incorrectly when dying while burrowing. 
[*]Fixed Arack sounds not being affected by the volume controls. 
[*]Fixed some cases where editor asset groups would not count towards the total asset number. 
[/list]
[b]Editor[/b]
[list]
[*]Standalone Enemy Spawner Volume: You can now add a volume that spawns the configured enemies when a player enters the volume.
[*]Wave Tags: In Conquer games you can now tag any wave as defensive wave so any player attacking a nest will trigger this wave instead of the standard 2 Arthos defensive wave. 
[*]Added 10 new skyboxes in the map editor (they will be replaced with the winners on Discord)
[/list]
That's it for now, fellow Guardians!! As always we hope you like this new update and please let us know what you think about the new features. 

Time to kill some bugs!

Cheers!

VirtualAge Games Team

notes.title: New Enemies Update!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

A new free update for Guardians Frontline (Update 5) is now officially live on Steam!

[previewyoutube=je4sVHbHXKI;full][/previewyoutube]

New stuff: 

- Three new species of bugs have been detected! 
- Arack Level 2: This new unit is capable of burrowing and launching surprise attacks. It is invulnerable below ground unless you use the tactical view to make them visible. 
- Insect Level 2: Bigger and stronger than regular insects, it launches a freezing attack that will paralyze any unit for 5s
- Siege Sentinel: This variant of the sentinel launches explosive projectiles at very long distances. It is a great complement to the linear attack of the sentinel as this one can launch parabolic shots. 
- Added 10 new rank levels to level 50! Who will be the first Guardian to reach Supreme Commander?
- Added the ultimate skin for Guardians that reach Lvl50! This skin also offers 30% extra protection against explosive damage to keep those pesky bug bombs at bay. 
- AK20 - Explosive projectiles: Added a secondary attack to the AK20, you can now shoot powerful explosive projectiles. 

Improvements:
 
- Added the option to create private games right from the Campaign section. 
- Added two more filters to the games list: slots available and game mode.
- Bugs will try to go to the nearest portal if they don't have a valid path to their targets.
- Improved sword blast usability and added tips. 
- Added new sound effects to the insects and scorpion.
- Added new capability to nests to trigger defensive waves in conquer if the player attacks them (enabled in the map editor)
- Added option to reconnect
- Added new map section “Creators highlights” where certified map makers can showcase their latest maps (see map editor section for more details)
- Added more information to clearly differentiate between personal and team influence.

Rating system changes: 

-Added a feedback form to let players inform when they rate a map as 1s (performance, game issues, etc.)
- The rating screen will only appear if the map is played in Normal, Hard or Insane, and the player has played for more than 8 minutes. 
- Changed the rating formula of maps until they have 25 votes to include mean and median. This change will take into consideration 

Fixes:
 
- Join list breaks when attempting to join someone offline or in full room
- Fixed the Environmental effects are too loud on PC
- Fixed ancient ladder asset missing faces. 
- Fixed some landscape settings not saving correctly. 
- Fixed laser traps blocking passage sometimes.
- Fixed several errors that could potentially create performance problems 
- Fixed the "get all updates" accolade grayed out even though it was already completed.
- Fixed bots being created in PvP games but not showing up in the player’s list.
- Fixed mind control barrels not disappearing sometimes. 
- Fixed if you set bugs to despawn option it switches it back when you play the published map. 
- Fixed when you save with despawn bugs at stage end it also breaks lights so when you hold gun the light remains fixed to head.
- Added limits to the environmental effects intensity selectors to avoid visual artifacts when going over range.
- Fix: Potential fix for some players getting kicked out when they jump into a vehicle
- Fixed a color bug with the blades, when you change the color of the blade (to any color besides blue), then change the sword types, the glowing effect/fog around it is still blue
- Fixed being able to start a new galaxy conquest without pressing the Start button. 

Balance: 

- Reduced damage of swords to 0.1 vs 0.2 before on Lvl2 nests. 

Editor:

- Conquer spawn mode: added the option to use all nests as possible spawn points instead of just the 2 closest to target. 
- Ability to increase the HP of the nests
- The biome filter is now out of beta and available to everyone! You can now merge assets from different biomes in your maps like putting ice spires on the desert. 
- Certified map makers can now highlight one of their maps and it will automatically show up in the “Creators highlights” section. Each map maker can only show one map at a time. Adding the map to this section will remove it from Featured or Top Rated if it’s there too. 
- More co-authoring and collab options (beta):
- Added a new customizable Author field to publish maps as joint col·laborations
- Transfer map: You can now transfer maps to other map makers
- Co-Op editor fixes
- Pieces disappear when someone leaves the editor
- Cloning doesn't work
- Grouping doesn’t work
- Only host can touch terrain
- Locking all objects breaks things
- Added Sound trigger volumes so you can play specific sounds when the player is inside them.
- Added 6 new music tracks
- Added the option to create Bugs-only kill meshes
- Added new tool to smooth terrain (still working on the Q3 issue)
- Added option to disable tactical view
- Added new Lightning and electric assets!
- Added explosive barrels as placeable assets
- Added a new ancient animated door
- Added the option to automatically open and close the doors when nearby. Enemies and allied units will automatically go through the door in this mode.
- Added a new ancient destroyable wall
- Added landed dropship as asset. This is the same dropship that we use in the campaign that takes off after pressing start. 
- Added a new Supply Crate Respawner! This asset will automatically respawn a dropship crate on top of it at the frequency that you specify in the editor. 

As always we hope you like this new update and please let us know what you think about the new features. 

That's it for now fellow Guardians, time to kill some bugs!

Cheers!

VirtualAge Games Team

notes.title: Update 12 now live!
notes.notes:
Hello fellow Guardians!

Update 12 is now live! 

[b]NEW OFFICIAL MAP[/b]
Thermogen (Conquer game mode) is set in a Thermal Generation plant in Titan. Your mission is to find and destroy all the alien nests and restore the power. 

[b]TACTICAL VIEW[/b]
You can now switch to a bird's eye view of the battlefield and back to combat view again from the click of a button in the contextual menu! This new perspective makes it much easier to micro your units, and also provides an excellent perspective of the battlefield.  You can move around with the joystick as always, but also by pressing the grip button with an empty hand moving the controller, as if you were climbing. Also, if you press both trigger buttons you can zoom in/out and rotate the battlefield. In this mode you can also spawn units around your teammates and around the warp gate.

[b]NEW GALAXY CONQUEST CAMPAIGN[/b]
The ultimate battle against the bugs has started! The new galaxy conquest is a shared campaign with all players, where the fate of the galaxy depends on all Guardians joining forces against the bugs. 
At the beginning of the campaign, all the planets are neutral except the Guardians' home world and the Bug's home world.
Every time you play a mission in one of the galaxy planets and win it, you will add a variable amount of influence points to that planet. We add 1-2-4-8 points per player depending on the difficulty level (easy-normal-hard-insane). When the planet reaches 100 community influence points, we (the Guardians) capture the planet!

[b]NEW ENEMIES[/b]
Reaver: This enemy fires a freezing ray that will completely immobilize players and units for a few seconds. You can find it in the Snow Protect level or in the practice range. It is also available in the editor.
Arak: The Arak is a fast spider that can jump on its target to inflict extra damage. You can find it in all Zephyr levels in the campaign as well as in the practice range and the lobby.

[b]SQUAD MODE[/b]
Continuing the initiative of deepening the Coop features in the game we started in the last release, in this one we introduce Squad mode! 
When you activate this option in the game creation screen, the whole team gets: shared resources, super long respawn times (so you are forced to revive your teammates if they die), and friendly fire for an extra layer of fun! But in this mode you can spawn units while you are downed ;).

[b]MANUAL RELOAD [/b]
Added manual reload to all weapons as an option. To eject the clip either pull it out with the trigger button or press B to eject it. The jetpack/teleporter now works by pressing the joystick forward. 
In manual reload mode, weapons have x2 bullets per magazine and deal extra 50% damage to compensate for the loss of speed and double wielding that you get in semi-auto mode.
Changed the sounds of the AK5 to make it feel more powerful.
Improved the bullet counters so it’s more integrated with the weapon and more visible

[b]NEW TECH[/b]
- Energy shield: this new upgrade to the wall generates a force field that can protect a small number of units or structures from ranged attacks. You can unlock it by completing all the levels in the Zephyr planet (campaign)
- Machine gun: Added a machine gun upgrade for the cannon: It will increase turn speed x4, change to hitline damage, and reduce the range to 75%

[b]RESEARCH[/b]
We simplified the research system so now instead of having to complete all the missions in a particular planet to get a reward and then pay for the upgrade with crystals, now you can research any upgrade if you have enough Research points. You can get Research points by completing missions in the galaxy and soon by other methods too. Stay tuned!

[b]MAP EDITOR IMPROVEMENTS[/b]
We continued to expand the editor with more features and even more assets: 
- Precision Mode: Enable it in the settings menu, this mode allows you to zoom in/out of the map and activates more precise colliders. This allows working on very small details and interior areas that were very hard to do before.
- Multiselect and clone: You can now select multiple objects and move them together as a single object, and even clone the whole group. To do it, enable precision mode and keep the right trigger button pressed for a few seconds. You’ll see a blue ribbon following the path of the controller that works as a lasso to select the objects. Press double trigger to deselect them. We are still working on this feature so expect a few glitches here and there.
-Autosave: We added a new feature in the settings menu that will automatically save the map every 15minutes. 
-Negative height offset: we added negative values to the height offset so you can easily work on areas close to the terrain.

You can check out the full release notes in our discord server: https://discord.gg/bUGUnSDdSa

Thank you for supporting Guardians!

- How it works:
o	When the game starts it places a spawner at a random location around the map.
o	Every few seconds the spawner will send larvae to other mineral spots and try to expand there. 
o	If a spawner is next to a mineral spot it will start to eat its resources, build defenses and grow (see below). 
o	Every once in a while the Overmind (that’s how we call it :P), will try to destroy you, of course.

[b]NEW: In-Game level editor (solo or co-op) - Beta! [/b]

-    You can now create your own maps in single player or co-op sessions in the game. 
-    Maps are saved to our cloud. This means that a) you won’t lose your maps if you factory reset, and b) if you make any changes to the map, the other players will automatically download them the next time they play on that map. 
-    Two game modes are available now: Defense (Co-Op) and Destroy the gate (PvP). Protect and Elimination will come with the next update. 
-    You can configure the level as you want: terrain size, enemy spawn points, wave configuration, rocks, plants, towers, minerals, warp gate position… 
-    Fully dynamic terrain! You can raise, lower and paint the terrain in real-time.
-    Custom loadouts: you can define which weapons are allowed in your maps. Want to do a grenades only level? No problem :) 
-    If the map is set as “Public”, other players will be able to play on them too, and if you set them to editable, they will also be able to use them as templates for their own maps.

As I mentioned earlier the editor is still in public beta, so expect to find some bugs and rough edges while we still work on it. The high level roadmap for the next few releases is:
-    More assets/props
-    More biomes (snow is next)
-    Fixes and quality of life improvements 
-    A LOT more game play parameters for you to play with.

[b]NEW: Community maps! 
[/b]
We added a new section under Co-op and PvP that will feature the best maps created by the community, and to kick start this section we have added 3 new maps!
-    Desert Oasis (Co-Op Hard) 
-    Desert Hill (Co-Op Normal)
-    Crawly Canyon (Co-Op Hard) – By @lilmatthew!

We will be adding many more over the coming days and weeks as you guys start showing us your creations! 

For now community maps are only playable as multiplayer games, but if you want to play solo just create a private coop game. We will add the possibility to play this maps on single player mode in the next update. 
 
[b]Other Improvements: [/b]
-    Improved the tutorial step where we explain the jet pack. 
-    (Steam Only) Added specific text for HP Reverb G2 buttons. 
-    Added “Coming soon” to Snow Rescue chapter button.
-    Custom mode: You can now define HP and Damage bonus to all enemies of a particular wave. 
-    New: Visual inventory ON by default for new installs
-    New: Added throw boost to the sword
-    New: UI Multi-language support
-   Several Memory optimizations for Quest

[b]Fixes:[/b]
-    Fixed custom waves with only bosses not ending 
-    Fixed energy sword killing your own units. 
-    Fixed enemies would not retreat when ordered, especially the tank.
-    Fixed woman avatar incorrect hand poses when wielding the gun
-    Fixed bugs not attacking the walls placed on a bridge even if they blocked the path.

As always, please let us know your feedback or if you find any bugs. 

Thanks!!
